categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Zhimingda Electronics Co., Ltd primarily operates in the design, development, and manufacturing of customized embedded computer modules and solutions. Its products serve key national sectors including airborne, missile-borne, naval, vehicle-mounted, satellite, and unmanned equipment embedded systems. The company focuses on embedded computing hardware and software integration for defense and aerospace applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary embedded system technologies including embedded real-time operating systems, FPGA-based high-speed data buses, AI-enabled image perception and processing, inertial navigation signal acquisition, and high-reliability power supplies. It employs hardware-software co-design with customization for client-specific applications, emphasizing low power, high reliability, wide temperature range, and miniaturization. Production combines in-house manufacturing with outsourced processing, following a make-to-order model with rigorous quality control and traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major Chinese national defense and aerospace groups such as China Electronics Technology Group, China Aviation Industry Group, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, and China Ordnance Industry Group. The end markets include national defense airborne systems, missile guidance and control, naval vessels, ground vehicles, satellites, and unmanned aerial vehicles. The company’s products are embedded in critical defense equipment requiring high reliability and performance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Its customer base is concentrated in domestic national defense and aerospace sectors. There is no significant international sales or operations disclosed.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhimingda operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of embedded computing modules that serve as critical components integrated into larger defense and aerospace systems. It procures electronic components and integrated circuits upstream and supplies embedded modules downstream to system integrators and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in embedded computing technologies, including next-generation avionics buses, ultra-high-speed inter-board communication, AI-based image perception and processing, inertial navigation signal acquisition, and high-capacity storage. It invests heavily in R&D (about 18.6% of revenue) to enhance core competencies and expand product lines. Strategic R&D also targets full domestic localization of chips and operating systems, multi-core and multi-processor architectures, and integrated software development environments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized embedded computer modules and related software solutions. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on customer contracts, with direct sales to large national defense groups. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and acceptance of products. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with large state-owned enterprises and affiliated research institutes in the Chinese national defense embedded systems market. While these state-owned entities have advantages in scale and longstanding relationships, Zhimingda leverages its technological agility, cost advantages, and customer service to gain market share. It is recognized as a leading private enterprise in the embedded computing sector for national defense applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 663 million, a 22.58% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 96.3 million, up 27.73%. Total assets were around RMB 1.53 billion with net assets of RMB 1.09 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased order deliveries and expanded market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhimingda emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary embedded system technologies, and ability to deliver highly reliable, customized embedded computing solutions tailored to stringent national defense requirements. Its products offer high performance, low power consumption, environmental robustness, and integration of AI for intelligent processing. The company’s focus on domestic localization and cost-effective design provides competitive advantages in the evolving defense electronics market.
